smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Compute the area of the polygon formed by connecting the roots of $$x^{10}+x^9+x^8+x^6+x^5+x^4+x^2+x+1$$ graphed in the complex plane with line segments in counterclockwise order.

smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-02.prompt: $f(x)$ is a nonconstant polynomial. Given that $f(f(x))+f(x)=f(x)^2$, compute $f(3)$.

smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $f(x)=x^3-6x^2+\frac{25}{2}x-7$. There is an interval $[a,b]$ such that for any real number $x$, the sequence $x,f(x),f(f(x)),\cdots$ is bounded (i.e., has a lower and upper bound) if and only if $x\in[a,b]$. Compute $(a-b)^2$.
